reviews.title: Bummer
reviews.text:
Moving the community forum behind a pay wall is a major loser move. Wow that sucks. Bye. 
I understand wanting to have premium features but it’s a slap in the face to move something that used to be free for users behind a paywall like that. Especially when it means having to pay to access previous connections and conversations with people again. Feels gross. Also insulting to charge for content that still needs to be proof-read for basic grammar errors.
Oh cool just realized the main thing I used to use on here that helped me the most is also behind the paywall. The symptom tracker. This app is essentially no longer free. I’m extremely disappointed.

reviews.title: Addiction specialist
reviews.text: This app has been very helpful for my patients who are chronic smokers to keep track of their use to work toward reducing their smoking. It also has been really helpful for many of them to see their symptoms improving as time goes on and being able to see how much funds they are saving.

reviews.title: Cold Turkey app only
reviews.text: I like the app. It’s helpful to check in and be accountable to myself. I used cannabis to taper off Benzos. The cannabis helps me sleep. Now I wish to taper off of cannabis but this app only allows cold turkey reduction. I will taper 10% each week so I don’t suffer through withdrawals and quit. Unfortunately, I don’t see how this app helps with tapering. Why go through this cold turkey?

reviews.title: This app helped me get 1 year off weed.
reviews.text: An app can’t make changes in your life for you, but this one is great. The symbol of the tree growing reminds you how long change takes. I was depressed for months after quitting weed and only as my tree really started to grow did I start to feel better. This amazing app helps you be patient with yourself. The only thing I could ask is for there to be new trees past one year. But I’m proud of myself this app helped me thank you.

reviews.title: Welcome home
reviews.text:
Using a no-smoking weed app has genuinely changed my life in ways I didn’t expect. What started as just tracking days turned into watching real progress, and that progress became inspiring. Seeing myself stay consistent reminded me that I can follow through, and that alone rebuilt a lot of confidence I thought I lost.

Since quitting, so many feelings have returned — clarity, motivation, optimism, and genuine happiness. I feel grounded again. My mind is sharper, my emotions are more balanced, and I’m present in my daily life instead of drifting through it. I wake up with purpose and go to sleep proud of myself.

The app helped me stay accountable, but more importantly, it helped me believe in myself again. Every milestone feels earned, and each day strengthens my resolve. My long-term goal is 5+ years of staying grounded, clear-headed, and fully aligned with the best version of myself.

Grateful for this journey and for the tools that helped me get here. Thank you 🙏🏾

reviews.title: Apps Should Not Frequently Beg For Reviews
reviews.text: I actually like this app but I am giving it 1 star as it frequently pesters you to either rate it or buy the pro edition. I don't mind an occasional ad for pro, but the nonstop frequent requests for a rating with no option to say "Stop Asking Me" is bad app design. If a developer adds this as an option I will happily edit my review.
